description: Source code for 3D convolution operations in PyTorch's ATen library, including functions for forward and backward passes, shape checks, and tensor transformations related to 3D convolution.

methods.name: compute_columns3d
methods.description: Computes the column representation of 3D input tensor for convolution.

methods.name: slow_conv3d_shape_check
methods.description: Checks the validity of input tensor shapes and parameters for 3D convolution.

methods.name: view_weight_2d
methods.description: Reshapes 5D weight tensor to 2D for matrix multiplication.

methods.name: slow_conv3d_update_output_frame
methods.description: Performs a single frame update for the forward pass of 3D convolution.

methods.name: slow_conv3d_backward_update_grad_input_frame
methods.description: Computes gradient w.r.t. input for a single frame during backward pass.

methods.name: slow_conv3d_backward_weight_frame
methods.description: Computes gradient w.r.t. weight for a single frame during backward pass.

methods.name: slow_conv3d_backward_out_cpu_template
methods.description: Computes gradients for input, weight, and bias during backward pass.

methods.name: slow_conv3d_forward_out_cpu
methods.description: Performs the forward pass of 3D convolution, outputting to provided tensor.

methods.name: slow_conv3d_forward_cpu
methods.description: Performs the forward pass of 3D convolution, returning new tensor.

methods.name: slow_conv3d_backward_out_cpu
methods.description: Computes gradients during backward pass, outputting to provided tensors.

methods.name: slow_conv3d_backward_cpu
methods.description: Computes gradients during backward pass, returning gradients for input, weight, bias.

methods.name: slow_conv3d_out
methods.description: Wrapper for forward convolution with output tensor.

methods.name: slow_conv3d
methods.description: Wrapper for forward convolution returning new tensor.
